history.overview: The Ritual Chambers were the heart of oceanic planar rites, now destabilized by Discord corruption.

timeline.name: Ritual Chambers Constructed
timeline.description: Built to conduct oceanic planar rites and bind tidal energy.

timeline.name: Planar Water Conduits Activated
timeline.description: Water conduits were used to channel oceanic planar energy.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord ruptures twisted ritual circles and destabilized planar flows.

timeline.name: Muramite Disruption
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to sabotage the rites to collapse Uqua’s defenses.
